description: Complete mathematical, Lean 4 mechanized formal verification, and C/GMP empirical search dataset for Candidate C623. Includes formal proofs in Lean 4 with 0 sorry/admit, Kraus modular elimination sieve records for 2,565 prime exponents in [5501, 30000] (100% elimination rate), and exhaustive empirical certificates for over 1.059 Trillion candidate pairs clean of primitive counterexamples.
